batch_groups.name: Engine Core + Faigate Adapter
batch_groups.reason: Council Engine + Faigate Routing = Kern-Logik, abhängig

objectives: LLM Council Engine mit 3-Stage-Deliberation (Opinions → Peer Review → Synthesis)
Faignite als Model-Router (Verfügbarkeit + Guthaben-Check vor Query)
Ablösung von last30days in Discovery-Phase durch council

tasks.title: src/skillweave/council/engine.py
tasks.description: CouncilEngine: asyncio.gather-basierte 3-Stage-Orchestrierung (deliberate, stage1_opinions, stage2_review, stage3_synthesis), anonmyization via label_to_model, ranking aggregation
acceptanceCriteria: deliberate(query, config) returns CouncilResult mit stage1/stage2/stage3
Stage 1: Alle Modelle parallel via asyncio.gather, failed models gracefully skipped
Stage 2: Responses anonymized (Response A/B/C), FINAL RANKING: Format geparst
Stage 3: Chairman erhält alle Responses + Rankings + Search Context
Timeout: 30s pro Modell, 120s Gesamt

tasks.title: src/skillweave/council/faigate_adapter.py
tasks.description: FaigniteProvider: check_availability, check_credits, query, get_available_models, best_fit (nach Council-Profil)
acceptanceCriteria: check_availability(models) prüft alle Modelle via Faigate API
check_credits(model) liefert Guthaben-Stand
query(model, messages, temperature) sendet via Faigate API
best_fit(profile) wählt optimale Modelle für quick/standard/deep/expert
Failed availability → Modell wird aus Council ausgeschlossen (kein Abbruch)

tasks.title: src/skillweave/council/search.py
tasks.description: WebSearch: DuckDuckGo (default, free), Serper, Tavily, Brave — hybrid web+news, relevance reranking, Jina Reader für Full Content
acceptanceCriteria: DuckDuckGo funktioniert ohne API-Key (default)
Serper/Tavily/Brave via configurable API-Keys
Relevance-Reranking: Token-Overlap auf Title (0.4), Summary (0.35), URL (0.15), Freshness (0.1)
Jina Reader fetch für top 3 results (optional, on/off)
Result-Format: Result N: Title / URL / Content (truncated 2000 chars)
60s total search budget

tasks.title: Zeitraum-Suche in search.py + engine.py
tasks.description: time_range Parameter (30d/quarter/6mo/1yr/any) — DuckDuckGo timelimit + post-hoc date filter für Serper/Tavily
acceptanceCriteria: 30d: DuckDuckGo timelimit='m', post-hoc filter auf alle results
quarter: DuckDuckGo timelimit='m', post-hoc filter (weiter wegen DDG limitation)
6mo: DuckDuckGo timelimit='w' (best effort), strict post-hoc filter
1yr: DuckDuckGo timelimit='y', post-hoc filter
any: Kein Filter
Post-hoc: parse date from result, filter by range

tasks.title: src/skillweave/council/synthesis.py mit JSON Schema Output
tasks.description: Structured JSON Output mit JSON Schema-Validierung — Chairman-Synthese als optionaler JSON-Output neben Markdown
acceptanceCriteria: output_format='json' → Chairman antwortet mit JSON nach Schema
JSON Schema: {title, summary, key_insights: [], consensus_score: float, dissent: str|null, sources: []}
Schema-Validierung via jsonschema vor Return
output_format='markdown' → Standard-Markdown wie bisher
Fallback: bei JSON-Validierungsfehler → Markdown (mit warning)

tasks.title: src/skillweave/council/profiles.py — Council Profiles
tasks.description: 4 vordefinierte Council-Profile: default (4 models balanced), quick (2 models fast), deep (6 models diverse), expert (4 models domain-specific)
acceptanceCriteria: default: 4 models (balanced mix), chairman via Faigate best_fit
quick: 2 models (fastest available), no chairman (mode=quick)
deep: 6 models (diverse providers), mode=full
expert: 4 models (domain-tuned), chairman scientific
Jedes Profil definiert: models[], chairman, mode, temperature

tasks.title: prompts.py + engine.py Integration
tasks.description: Stage 1/2/3 Prompt-Templates mit Phasen-Kontext (phase parameter injects domain-specific prompts)
acceptanceCriteria: Stage 1 Prompt: Council persona + search context + query
Stage 2 Prompt: Anonymized responses + FINAL RANKING: format enforcement
Stage 3 Prompt: Chairman persona + all data + output_format instruction
phase='discovery' injects market-research prompt prefix
phase='design' injects design-evaluation prompt prefix
Phase-Null (standalone): generic prompt

tasks.title: skills/skillweave-council/ SKILL.md + capability.yaml
tasks.description: Volle SKILL.md mit YAML-Frontmatter, Usage, Commands, Council-Profile, Search-Provider, Output-Format + capability.yaml
acceptanceCriteria: SKILL.md YAML: name=skillweave-council, description, argument-hint: topic="[topic]" time_range="[30d|quarter|6mo|1yr|any]" mode="[quick|standard|full]" profile="[default|quick|deep|expert]" output="[markdown|json]"
Commands: deliberate, search, compare (nur Stage 1), profiles
capability.yaml: kind=skill, capabilities: council_deliberation, web_search, model_routing, peer_review, synthesis

tasks.title: phases.yaml Update: last30days → council
tasks.description: In phases.yaml: discovery-Phase bekommt council statt last30days, design und post-release optional council erhalten
acceptanceCriteria: discovery: skills=[skillweave-discovery, skillweave-blueprint, skillweave-council]
design: skills=[skillweave-design, frontend-design] + optional skillweave-council
post-release: skills=[... bestehende, skillweave-council]
last30days entfernt aus phases.yaml (war nie originär)
global_skills unverändert (lifecycle, repo-health, observe)

Test: Stage 1 graceful failure (1 model fails, 3 succeed)
Test: Stage 2 anonymization + ranking parse
Test: Stage 3 markdown synthesis
Test: Stage 3 JSON output + schema validation
Test: Faignite availability check (mock)

Test: Council Profile default/quick/deep/expert

Serper/Tavily/Brave API Keys via .skillweave/config.yaml oder ENV
Keine Web-UI nötig — reiner CLI-Skill für Agenten
Council arbeitet standalone und als Phase-Skill (discovery, design, post-release)
